item.title: Schuylkill County Conservancy Announces December Sketchers Walk, New Year’s Day Nature Hike
item.description: The Schuylkill County Conservancy and local partners are inviting the public to take part in two upcoming outdoor events designed to connect residents with nature through creativity and exploration. Schuylkill County Sketchers Nature Walk The first event, a Schuylkill County Sketchers Nature Walk, will take place on Saturday, December 20, from 10:00 to 11:00 a.m. at Sweet Arrow Lake Park in Pine Grove. item.title: Scooter Rider Injured in Late-Night Crash on Route 61 in Pottsville
item.description: A Pottsville man was injured late Thursday night after an electric scooter was struck by a tractor-trailer on Route 61. According to Pottsville police, the crash occurred on Thursday, December 11, 2025, at approximately 11:30 p.m. in the 400 block of North Claude A. Lord Boulevard. Officers were dispatched to the scene for a reported motor vehicle accident involving a tractor-trailer and an electric scooter. item.title: North Schuylkill Class of 2000 Holds 25 Year Reunion
item.description: The North Schuylkill High School Class of 2025 gathered for a class reunion on Saturday, November 29, 2025, at the Fountain Springs Country Inn. More class reunions and alumni events are encouraged to submit their information and photos to Skook News for community coverage at skooknews@outlook.com.
